lines: Initial build. National backdrop: unemployment 4.3%, 6.9M openings, hires rate 3.5%, 0.9 openings per unemployed worker — an employer's market.
Sector split intact: healthcare +680.5k jobs YoY vs. federal government −330k. Tech's Information sector is in its 16th straight month of losses.
Metro stress: Washington DC postings ~35% below 2020; Seattle ~−23%. Memphis & Kansas City remain the most candidate-favorable.
